hazards.control: Hands clear of the injector chains, the reel, and the stripper door.

name: Drive chains and gripper blocks
function: The two chain loops with gripper blocks that clamp the coil between them and move it up or down as the chains turn.

tabs.overview: Blocks are contoured to the coil OD and changed for a different coil size; chain tension is hydraulic so the grip follows the pipe.
tabs.engineering: Block sets per coil size; chain tension setpoints per the coil and pressure.
tabs.safety: Pinch points; blocks and chains inspected for wear each job.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
